entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.27534 Of 2010
Order:

This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a Writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate Writ, Order or Direction declaring the impugned action of the respondents in trying to enter into the petitioners' land and disturbing peaceful possession and enjoyment of the petitioner No.1 in Survey No.798/AA of an extent of 0.10 guntas, in survey No.799/AA of extent 0.30 guntas of the petitioner No.2 in Survey No.798/E of an extent 0.10 guntas, in survey No.799/A of extent of 0.30 guntas

; of the petitioner No.3 is survey No.798/A of an extent of 0.11 guntas, in survey No.799/E of extent of 0.29 guntas; total admeasuring an extent of Ac.3.00 cents of Painampalli Village, Nelakondapalli Mandal, Khammam district without even disposing the petitioners' objections under Section 5(a) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act')
and without completing the land acquisition proceedings as also changing the details of land including survey numbers without issuing any modified notification etc., as against the principles of natural justice and without following due process of law as illegal, arbitrary and violative of principles of natural justice etc., and consequently direct the respondents not to disturb the peaceful possession and enjoyment of the petitioner No.1 in survey No.798/AA of an extent of 0.10 guntas, in survey No.799/AA of extent of 0.30 guntas; of the petitioner No.2 in survey No.798/E of an extent of 0.10 guntas in Survey No 799/A of extent of 0.30 guntas; of the petitioner No.3 in Survey No.798/A of extent of 0.11 SK,J guntas, in Survey No.799/E of extent of 0.29 guntas; total admeasuring an extent of Ac.3.00 cents of Painampalli Village,
Nelakondapalli Mandal, Khammam District without disposing the objections raised under the provisions of Section 5(a) of the Act before proceedings any further in the matter and grant such other relief or reliefs as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case"
2. Heard Learned Counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondents.

3. Learned Government Pleader for the respondents basing on the counter averments submits that the proposals have been initiated for acquisition of land measuting Ac.3.00 guntas in Sy.No.798 and 799, situated at Painampally Village of Nelakondapally Mandal, Khammam District for providing house sites to the beneficiaries under Indiramma Phase-II under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act.

So far, the possession of the land has not been taken from the petitioners and SK,J necessary Nagubandi Janaiah vs The Secretary To The Government on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98956386/
1 action is being taken to take possession of land in accordance with the provisions of Land Acquisition Act.
4. In view of the submission made by the learned Government Pleader, the present writ petition is disposed of by directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner in the subject property, without following due process of law.
